facts.statement: Hungarosaurus was a quadruped with a body covered in hundreds of osteoderms.
facts.quote: Hungarosaurus walked on four legs and its body was covered with hundreds of osteoderms.

facts.statement: Mature specimens of Hungarosaurus reached a length of about 4 to 4.8 meters.
facts.quote: The length of mature specimens was about 4 - 4.8 m.
Hungarosaurus was a small nodosaur, measuring 4 - 4.8 m in length and weighing 650 - 1000 kg.

facts.statement: Hungarosaurus had unusually long forelimbs that were nearly as long as its hindlimbs.
facts.quote: The forelimbs were unusually long for an ankylosaur, being nearly as long as the hindlimbs.

facts.statement: The ornamented skull of Hungarosaurus was estimated to be 32 to 36 centimeters long.
facts.quote: The skull of this dinosaur is ornamented and estimated to have been 32–36 centimetres in length.

facts.statement: The species was named by Attila Ősi in 2005.
facts.quote: The species was named by Attila Ősi in 2005.

facts.statement: The specific name 'tormai' honors amateur paleontologist András Torma, who discovered the fossil site in 2000.
facts.quote: The specific name honours András Torma, the amateur paleontologist who discovered the fossil site in 2000.

facts.statement: Four specimens were collected from an open-pit bauxite mine near Iharkút in the Bakony Mountains of western Hungary.
facts.quote: Four specimens of Hungarosaurus tormai are known, all collected from an open-pit bauxite mine near the village of Iharkút, Veszprém County, in the Bakony Mountains (Transdanubian Range) of western Hungary.

facts.statement: Cladistic analysis indicates Hungarosaurus is a derived member of the family Nodosauridae.
facts.quote: Cladistic analysis on the taxon indicates that it is a derived member of the Nodosauridae, along with Struthiosaurus (another European nodosaurid).

facts.statement: Hungarosaurus lived during the Santonian stage of the Upper Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Hungarosaurus walked on four legs and its body was covered with hundreds of osteoderms.

facts.statement: Dental wear evidence suggests Hungarosaurus sheared its food rather than just pulping it.
facts.quote: In contrast with earlier hypotheses that H. tormai fed via orthal pulping with little to no occlusion between maxillary and mandibular teeth, dental wear shows that it sheared its food.

facts.statement: Hungarosaurus used a masticatory process involving an initial slicing phase followed by a retractive powerstroke with significant occlusion.
facts.quote: An slicing phase consisting of an orthal movement came first in the masticatory process; it was followed by a retractive powerstroke during which significant occlusion occurred.

facts.statement: Hungarosaurus stood about 1.3 meters tall and weighed approximately 500 kilograms.
facts.quote: Hungarosaurus fue un dinosaurio acorazado de aproximadamente entre 4 y 4,5 metros largo, 1,3 de alto y un peso de 500 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Ankylosaurian fossils in Europe have been found in England, Austria, western Romania, France, and northern Spain.

facts.statement: The fossil record for Hungarosaurus spans from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)
